content.value_statement: Network teams need clear reports from scattered infrastructure data. This skill turns health, device, client, WiFi, firewall, and capacity data into structured reports.
actual_capabilities: Generates network health reports from site health and device data.
Creates performance reports from device and client metrics.
Documents firewall zones, ACL rules, WiFi networks, and system information.
Produces device inventory reports and multi-site comparisons.
Summarizes recommendations, priorities, timelines, and executive views.
limitations: Depends on data returned by the connected network tools.
Does not collect data outside the listed tool set.
Cannot certify compliance without policies, controls, and reviewer approval.
Capacity forecasts are estimates and require human review.

use_cases.title: Weekly Health Reporting
use_cases.description: Create a weekly view of site health, device status, client impact, risks, and recommended actions.

use_cases.title: Security Audit Preparation
use_cases.description: Collect firewall zone, ACL, WiFi, and system details for audit review and evidence planning.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Planning
use_cases.description: Compare inventory, utilization, and trends to estimate upgrade timing and resource needs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Health Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a weekly network health report for all available sites. Include availability, device status, client impact, top risks, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Performance Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a monthly performance report. Compare device and client metrics. Identify bottlenecks and list recommended fixes by priority.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Security Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a security and compliance report. Review firewall zones, ACL rules, WiFi networks, and system information. Highlight gaps and needed evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Capacity and Executive Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a six month capacity report. Use inventory and performance trends. Compare sites, estimate upgrades, and draft an executive summary.

output_examples.input: Generate a weekly health report for all sites.
output: Executive summary with overall health, critical risks, and highest priority actions.
Site comparison table for availability, device status, and client impact.
Recommendation list grouped by urgency and owner.

output_examples.input: Create a security audit report for the network.
output: Segmentation review based on firewall zones and ACL rules.
WiFi and system information sections for audit evidence.
Gap list with risk level, evidence needed, and remediation owner.

output_examples.input: Prepare a capacity planning report for the next quarter.
output: Inventory summary with device utilization and site comparisons.
Projected capacity risks with suggested upgrade timing.
Executive action plan with priorities and estimated effort.

best_practices: Confirm tool access before requesting a report.
Ask for the audience, period, and sites in the prompt.
Review sensitive network details before sharing reports outside the team.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated capacity forecasts as approved budgets.
Do not publish security reports without removing sensitive network details.
Do not ask for compliance conclusions without providing the required standard.

faq.question: What data does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses available network health, device, client, WiFi, firewall, ACL, and system information from connected tools.

faq.question: Can it make executive summaries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize key risks, trends, actions, and business impact for stakeholders.

faq.question: Does it change network settings?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes reporting workflows and does not request configuration changes.

faq.question: Can it compare multiple sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize metrics by site when the connected tools provide site data.

faq.question: Is it a compliance certification tool?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare audit evidence and gaps, but a qualified reviewer must approve compliance conclusions.

faq.question: Can it forecast capacity needs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can estimate future needs from inventory and usage trends, but forecasts require human review.
